bar.account.hint: Logs you in to Drives - or, once you’re logged in, shows that you are.
bar.account.title: Your account

bar.addContact.hint: Adds someone to your messages, by the email address they use for Drives.
bar.addContact.title: Add a contact

bar.help.hint: Shows what the page is for, with a link to its full help on the website.
bar.help.title: Help

bar.menu.hint: Opens the Menu: your settings and details, groups, clubs, events and help.
bar.menu.title: Menu

bar.redo.hint: Puts back a change you’ve just undone.
bar.redo.title: Redo

bar.undo.hint: Takes back the last change to the trip, such as a waypoint added or removed.
bar.undo.title: Undo

bar.writeMessage.hint: Opens the box to write a message in, at the bottom of the conversation.
bar.writeMessage.title: Write a message

chip.addGreatRoad.hint: Starts a great road: the waypoints you add next are part of it, and the route between them is drawn in your great road colour.
chip.addGreatRoad.title: Great road mode

chip.aiAssist.hint: Plans a trip from a description of the drive you’d like.
chip.aiAssist.title: AI assist

chip.clear.hint: Clears the trip from the map, without saving it.
chip.clear.title: Clear route

chip.continueTracking.hint: Starts recording again after a pause.
chip.continueTracking.title: Continue tracking

chip.createManually.hint: Starts a trip that you plan yourself, waypoint by waypoint.
chip.createManually.title: Create manually

chip.editGreatRoad.hint: Opens the details of the great road under the cross-hairs, to change its description.
chip.editGreatRoad.title: Edit great road

chip.editRoute.hint: Lets you change a saved or recorded trip.
chip.editRoute.title: Edit route

chip.extendBoth.hint: Makes the spot under the cross-hairs the trip’s new start and its new end: the trip goes from here to its old start, round, and back here.
chip.extendBoth.title: Extend both ends

chip.extendEnd.hint: Makes the spot under the cross-hairs the trip’s new end.
chip.extendEnd.title: Extend end

chip.extendStart.hint: Makes the spot under the cross-hairs the trip’s new start.
chip.extendStart.title: Extend start

chip.follow.hint: Guides you round the trip, with the next turn shown at the top of the map and spoken, so you don’t miss it.
chip.follow.title: Follow drive

chip.greatRoadEnd.hint: Ends the great road at the last waypoint, and opens its details so you can say what makes it great.
chip.greatRoadEnd.title: Normal road mode

chip.group.hint: Lists the people on the group drive in the drawer, with the colour of their car on the map.
chip.group.title: Group

chip.insertWaypoint.hint: Adds a waypoint under the cross-hairs, between the two highlighted waypoints.
chip.insertWaypoint.title: Insert waypoint

chip.messages.hint: Shows the group drive’s messages in the drawer, where you can send one to everybody.
chip.messages.title: Messages

chip.pauseTracking.hint: Stops recording for a while - for a stop, or a stretch you don’t want in the trip.
chip.pauseTracking.title: Pause tracking

chip.pointOfInterest.hint: Adds a point of interest under the cross-hairs - somewhere worth stopping - and opens its details in the drawer.
chip.pointOfInterest.title: Point of interest

chip.removeWaypoint.hint: Removes the waypoint under the cross-hairs, and works the route out again without it.
chip.removeWaypoint.title: Remove waypoint

chip.reverseTrip.hint: Turns the trip round, so it starts at the end and finishes at the start - useful for a downloaded trip that’s nearer its end.
chip.reverseTrip.title: Reverse trip

chip.revisitWaypoint.hint: Goes back to the waypoint under the cross-hairs - for a trip that passes the same place twice, like a figure of eight.
chip.revisitWaypoint.title: Revisit waypoint

chip.saveTrip.hint: Saves the trip on your device, in Favourites.
chip.saveTrip.title: Save trip

chip.steps.hint: Shows every turn of the route in the drawer, as directions.
chip.steps.title: Steps

chip.stopFollowing.hint: Stops guiding you round the trip.
chip.stopFollowing.title: Stop following

chip.trackDrive.hint: Records your drive as you go: it starts the trip where you are, and adds a waypoint every two miles or so, so it’s easy to edit later.
chip.trackDrive.title: Track drive

chip.waypoint.hint: Adds a waypoint under the cross-hairs - a place the trip goes through.
chip.waypoint.title: Waypoint

fab.greatRoad.hint: Marks the road you’re on as a great road, from here.
fab.greatRoad.title: Great road

fab.location.hint: Centres the map on where you are.
fab.location.title: My location

fab.pointOfInterest.hint: Records a point of interest where you are.
fab.pointOfInterest.title: Point of interest

fab.preferences.hint: Sets how routes are worked out, and what’s shown on the map.
fab.preferences.title: Map preferences

fab.search.hint: Finds a place by its name and moves the map to it.
fab.search.title: Search

fab.zoom.hint: Zooms in for more detail or out to see more, one step at a time.
fab.zoom.title: Zoom

menu.clubs.hint: Your club: invitations to join one, finding a club and asking to join, and for its admin, running it.
menu.clubs.title: My clubs

menu.console.hint: Runs Drives: clubs, payments, AI assist’s use and the app’s use, and the feedback people send.
menu.console.title: Control panel

menu.deleteTrips.hint: Removes published trips from Drives for good.
menu.deleteTrips.title: Remove trips

menu.deleteUser.hint: Stops someone using Drives: their account is disabled, and their published trips stay until removed.
menu.deleteUser.title: Remove user

menu.events.hint: Lists the group drives you’ve been invited to: swipe right to accept, left to decline.
menu.events.title: Events to which I've been invited

menu.feedback.hint: Tells us about a problem, an idea or a question.
menu.feedback.title: Send feedback

menu.invite.hint: Invites someone to join Drives, by email.
menu.invite.title: Invite a new user

menu.markdownHome.hint: Changes what the Home page says - for a club’s admin, their club’s page; for MotaTek, Drives’ own.
menu.markdownHome.title: Edit Home page

menu.markdownShop.hint: Changes the Shop page’s offers - for a club’s admin, their club’s page; for MotaTek, Drives’ own.
menu.markdownShop.title: Edit Shop page

menu.myEvents.hint: Organises group drives - a trip, and the members of a group invited to drive it with you - and lists those you’ve organised.
menu.myEvents.title: Events I've organised

menu.myGroups.hint: Sets up and runs your groups - of friends, or club members - to message and invite to events together.
menu.myGroups.title: Groups I manage

menu.register.hint: Registers you with Drives, or, once you’re logged in, changes your details - your name, phone number and password.
menu.register.title: Register my details / Edit my details

menu.settings.hint: Changes how the app works for you: the colours of routes and great roads, your route preferences, what OpenStreetMap shows on the map, and so on.
menu.settings.title: App settings

trip.delete.hint: Deletes the trip from your device, for good.
trip.delete.title: Delete Trip

trip.load.hint: Opens the trip on the Explore page, to follow it or change it.
trip.load.title: Load Trip

trip.publish.hint: Shares the trip on Drives, for everyone to see in Published - its route, points of interest, great roads and photos.
trip.publish.title: Publish Trip

trip.synchronise.hint: Passes the trip between the web version of Drives and your phone, without logging in.
trip.synchronise.title: Synchronise Trip

great_drives.summary: Published shows the trips Drives users have shared, on the map: their routes, points of interest and great roads, with their ratings. Tap a trip's label for its details, and download the ones you like to drive or change.
great_drives.title: Published

home.summary: Home is the app's news page: trips worth driving, events and news. For most people MotaTek writes it; a club using Drives writes its own, for its members.
home.title: Home

menu.summary: The Menu holds everything that isn't on the main pages: your settings and details, groups, clubs, events, and help. On a phone it's behind the Menu button at the top left; on a computer, in the Overflow Menu at the top right.
menu.title: Menu

messages.summary: Messages is Drives' own messaging, for messages to other Drives users and to your groups. It works much like WhatsApp or Signal: messages arrive straight away while the app is open.
messages.title: Messages

my_drives.summary: Favourites is your own library of trips, kept on your device. Open one on the Explore page to drive or change it, publish it for others to enjoy, or delete those you no longer want.
my_drives.title: Favourites

my_trip.summary: Explore is where you plan a trip, edit it, save it and follow it. Plan one in any of three ways: ask AI assist for the sort of drive you'd like, place the waypoints yourself, or let Drives record a drive as you go. Move the map so the cross-hairs are where you want something, then tap a chip.
my_trip.title: Explore

overview.summary: Drives is for planning, sharing and driving memorable trips - on your own, with friends or with your club. This page covers what it does, how the help is organised, the controls you'll meet, and your account.
overview.title: Overview

shop.summary: Shop has offers for motorists - things to make your trips even better. You browse it when you want to: Drives never pushes adverts at you.
shop.title: Shop
